text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft whipped the crowd into a 
frenzy. Determined to surpass her Tiara 
Umamusume seniors, she chose the Sprinters 
Stakes as her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, one day, she fell asleep in the 
middle of a meal without realizing it, 
dreaming of a future Cesario. Things like 
this have been happening a lot lately...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, she spots an unexpected 
figure: the Oaks Umamusume she had watched 
race when she was little, along with her 
baby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The former Yushun Himba (Oaks) Umamusume 
said she was a fan of Rhein Kraft. She 
told her that once her child grew up, she 
wanted to show them Kraft's running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to run in a way that would make 
that girl look up to her. Rhein Kraft 
vowed to give it her all at the Sprinters 
Stakes.
